target.title: fix(slack): add default 30s timeout to read and write WebClients
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveSlackWebClientOptions` does not set a default request timeout. All read Slack API calls (`users.info`, `conversations.list`, `emoji.list`, `reactions.get`, etc.) could hang indefinitely if the Slack API is slow or unresponsive. The lookup client already had a 30s timeout (`SLACK_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS`), but the regular read client did not.

## Changes

- `extensions/slack/src/client-options.ts`:
  - Add `SLACK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` and apply it via `??=` to `resolveSlackWebClientOptions` (read client)
  - Reuse the same constant for `resolveSlackLookupClientOptions`, replacing the now-unnecessary duplicate `SLACK_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS`
  - **Not applied to `resolveSlackWriteClientOptions`** — mutating calls (`chat.postMessage` etc.) may be committed by Slack before the response arrives; a timeout would cause false failure reports and duplicate messages on retry
- Explicit `timeout: 0` (upload completion) is preserved by `??=`

## Review Response

Per ClawSweeper review (P1): "Do not impose the read timeout on all mutating calls." The default 30s timeout is now scoped to read/lookup clients only. Write client is left unchanged.

## Evidence

### Unit tests (3 timeout-related + 31 existing)

```
✓ applies default 30s timeout to read client when no timeout specified
✓ preserves explicit timeout override for read client (60_000)
✓ preserves explicit timeout override for write client (timeout: 0)
```

### Real behavior proof — controlled slow endpoint

Proof: point Slack WebClient at a local HTTP server with 32s delay (exceeds 30s default).

```
=== Part 1: Fast server (2s delay) — baseline ===
  ✓ read client (default timeout=30s): resolved at 2048ms
  ✓ read client (timeout=0):            resolved at 2004ms
  ✓ read client (timeout=60s):          resolved at 2003ms
  ✓ write client (no default timeout):  resolved at 2004ms

=== Part 2: Slow server (32s delay, exceeds 30s default) ===
[WARN] web-api:WebClient http request failed timeout of 30000ms exceeded
[WARN] web-api:WebClient http request failed timeout of 30000ms exceeded
[WARN] web-api:WebClient http request failed timeout of 30000ms exceeded
  ✗ read client (default timeout=30s, retries=2): "slack_webapi_request_error" at 92227ms
  ✓ read client (timeout=0, unbounded):           resolved at 32009ms
  ✓ write client (no default timeout):            resolved at 32008ms
```

Key findings:
- **30s default timeout fires**: The WARN logs confirm `timeout of 30000ms exceeded` on each request attempt (3 attempts × 30s = ~92s total with retry mechanism)
- **timeout: 0 overrides**: Explicit `{ timeout: 0 }` bypasses the default, request completes normally after server responds at 32s
- **Write client unaffected**: No default timeout — request completes normally at 32s

### Lint + type check

```
npx tsc --noEmit: no errors
```

**Diff (final):**
```diff
 const SLACK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
-const SLACK_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

 export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(...) {
   ...
   resolved.retryConfig ??= SLACK_DEFAULT_RETRY_OPTIONS;
+  resolved.timeout ??= SLACK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS;
 }

 export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(...) {
   ...
   resolved.retryConfig ??= SLACK_WRITE_RETRY_OPTIONS;
   // No default timeout — mutating calls need safe delivery semantics
 }

 export function resolveSlackLookupClientOptions(...) {
   ...
-  resolved.timeout ??= SLACK_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS;
+  resolved.timeout ??= SLACK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS;
 }
```
